retainedReviewTransfer.meaning: Three existing decisions are transferred unchanged for identical assets. Only their current evidence pointer changes; no new review or image alteration is claimed.

review.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1 media author, actual full-resolution and 360px inspection
review.notes: The common tail is on the cart. In the final 1600x900 mapping, 6 N measures 540 px and 4 N 360 px, against a 180 px reference for 2 N. Both tips are free. Signed addition gives +2 N. The zero-force note permits rest and constant velocity. Both forces refer to the same cart; no net arrow is drawn elsewhere.

review.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1 media author, actual full-resolution and 360px inspection
review.notes: The 40 N weight and its two component arrows all start on the block, and the block visibly contacts the slope. Lengths are 288 px for weight, 144 px parallel and about 249.415 px perpendicular, against 72 px per 10 N. The components add geometrically to the weight. Dashed parallels are construction lines without arrowheads. The arrow tips end away from drawn surface boundaries. Components replace the weight; contact normal is explicitly a different force.

review.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1 media author, actual full-resolution and 360px inspection
review.notes: The given +6 N resultant starts on the cart and points right; its hand-drawn full length is three 2 N reference lengths within the visible stroke width. Original aspect ratio is preserved by containing the generated bitmap in 1600x900 with side margins. At 2 kg, acceleration is +3 m/s^2. The zero-resultant note gives a=0. There is no detached acceleration arrow or request to derive the resultant from several forces.

review.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1 image-label correction author, actual full-resolution and 360 px inspection
review.notes: Only the existing FR = −4 N label moved from SVG (700, 390) to (700, 350), clear of the block outline. The force arrow still starts on the block, measures 360 px for 4 N and uses the unchanged 180 px reference for 2 N. Its direction, tip, stated positive velocity, mass, acceleration and stopping interval are unchanged. Both full-resolution and 360 px views were opened. The original SVG reproduces the prior JPEG byte-exactly; decoded pixels outside the two label JPEG regions are identical.

review.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1 image-label correction author, actual full-resolution and 360 px inspection
review.notes: Only the existing FH = 2000 N label moved from SVG (460, 300) to (900, 450), onto free background below the force-scale legend and above the mass. The inward force arrow still starts on the car, measures 180 px against a 90 px reference for 1000 N and ends freely 63 px before M. Road, car, force geometry, given maximum and all other wording are unchanged. Both full-resolution and 360 px views were opened. The original SVG reproduces the prior JPEG byte-exactly; decoded pixels outside the two label JPEG regions are identical.
